<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A product as a card: picture, optional badge, category, name, rating, summary, price (and the old price struck
  through when `compareAt` is higher) and an add button. Axes: layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image,
  none), ratio, rating (show, hide), action (button, none), density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Product, ProductLabels } from "./product-card.types";

export type ProductCardProps = {
  product: Product;
  labels: ProductLabels;
  badges: Record<string, string>;
  layout?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
  media?: "image" | "none";
  ratio?: "4/3" | "1/1" | "3/4";
  rating?: "show" | "hide";
  action?: "button" | "none";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import Rating from "../components/rating.vue";
import { at, cn, fmtMoney, tpl, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  product,
  labels,
  badges,
  layout = "vertical",
  media = "image",
  ratio = "4/3",
  rating = "show",
  action = "button",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<ProductCardProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ add: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="article"
    :class="cn(
      'flex flex-col gap-8 bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground inset-ring inset-ring-border rounded',
      'h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden',
      (((layout as string) === 'horizontal') ? 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row' : 'flex flex-col')
    )"
    data-slot="card"
    data-testid="item"
    :data-layout="layout"
  >
    <Box
      v-if="((media as string) === 'image')"
      :class="cn('relative shrink-0', (((layout as string) === 'horizontal') ? 'sm:w-48' : ''))"
    >
      <MediaFrame :alt="product.name" :src="product.image" :ratio="ratio" class="h-full" />
      <Badge
        v-if="product.badge"
        variant="default"
        size="default"
        class="absolute left-4 top-4"
        data-testid="badge"
      >
        {{ at(badges, product.badge) }}
      </Badge>
    </Box>
    <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
      <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
        {{ product.category }}
      </Text>
      <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="bold">
        <Link v-if="product.href" :href="urlOf(product.href)" variant="default" data-testid="open">
          {{ product.name }}
        </Link>
        <template v-else>
          {{ product.name }}
        </template>
      </Title>
      <Group v-if="((rating as string) === 'show')" gap="2">
        <Rating :value="product.rating" :label="tpl(labels.ratingLabel, product.rating)" />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ tpl(labels.reviews, product.reviews) }}
        </Text>
      </Group>
      <Text v-if="((density as string) === 'default')" size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {{ product.summary }}
      </Text>
      <Group gap="4" justify="between" class="mt-auto pt-2">
        <Group gap="2" align="baseline" class="flex-wrap">
          <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
            {{ fmtMoney(product.price, product.currency) }}
          </Text>
          <Text
            v-if="(product.compareAt && (product.compareAt > product.price))"
            tag="del"
            size="sm"
            class="relative text-muted-foreground"
            data-testid="compare-at"
          >
            <Inline class="sr-only">
              {{ labels.was }}
            </Inline>
            {{ fmtMoney(product.compareAt, product.currency) }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <Button v-if="((action as string) === 'button')"
          :variant="(product.inStock ? 'default' : 'outline')"
          size="sm"
          :disabled="!product.inStock"
          data-testid="add"
          @click="() => emit('add', product.id)"
        >
          {{ (product.inStock ? labels.add : labels.soldOut) }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </CardContent>
  </Block>
</template>
